messages:
vika_design: dropped a design for a 'function override' affordance in run history. idea: a tiny badge on runs that have an override + a compact preview popover showing the overridden function signature and sample output. mock: https://redwood.mock/s/override-badge.png sam_devex: I like the badge for scannability. question: should the popover show a diff (old vs new signature) or just the active signature? tara_pm: product requirement: always show both in history (for auditability). in the popover we can show a one-line diff summary and a link to full diff in the inspector. noah_a11y: accessibility notes: popover must be dismissible with Esc, focus trap optional since it's lightweight, and it must be announced when opened: aria-live polite region saying "Override preview opened for run ". badge needs aria-describedby pointing to provenance text. ali_engineer: implementation constraints: we should lazy-load the overridden schema and sample. small diff renderer is ok. caching by override-id will help. code snippet for the badge and popover toggle: ```html
sig: summarize(text) -> summary (was: parse(text) -> parsed)
Open full diff
``` meera_research: from a small probe, users wanted the badge to be minimally styled but clickable. they liked seeing a tiny sample output in the popover (one sentence) to gauge impact. also asked for an explicit "Apply to new runs" CTA vs "Apply now" wording. vika_design: copy candidates: badge label: "Override", popover CTA: "Apply to subsequent runs" vs "Apply now" vs "Use override". I prefer "Apply to subsequent runs" because it clarifies it won't retroactively change past outputs. sam_devex: +1 to not imply retroactive changes. UX behaviour: when user clicks Apply, we should surface a non-blocking toast: "Override applied to future runs Rerun now" with an action. avoid auto-rerun. tara_pm: telemetry: emit events for override_view, override_apply, override_undo. metric: percent of override views that become apply within 60s. helps tuning defaults. noah_a11y: microcopy tweak: badges should include aria-label like "Override applied on 2026-03-22 by vika_design". popover should include a heading with role=heading and level announced to assistive tech. ensure color contrast meets AA. ali_engineer: backend: store override metadata on run: {override_id: \"ov-42\", from_signature: \"parse(text)\", to_signature: \"summarize(text)\", sample: \"Short summary...\", applied_by: \"vika_design\", ts: 1777770001}. UI will render only summary string. meera_research: small test result: 8/12 users expected an "undo" within 30s. propose showing an Undo action in the toast for 30s. vika_design: will update mocks to use copy: badge text "Override", popover CTA "Apply to subsequent runs", toast text "Override saved Undo Rerun". also add a subtle provenance line in run row: "override by vika_design". ci-bot: ci-bot: playground/function-override-badge branch build queued (id: 8822)
